alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. The blue one, the waiter, says enjoy! with a happy pulse. The black one answers you too! and a second later its eyes go wide and it trembles as it realizes. It says wait... and the blue one answers you too! right back. Both laugh with happy eyes and a bubble that says ha ha. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me telling the waiter you too.
